threelayer_separation.layer_a_os: arifOS — constitutional kernel (this work targets here)
threelayer_separation.layer_c_constitutional: arifOS canon (this is what gets distilled)

al_fatihah_kernel.role: Boot ROM + Security Context — kernel of arifOS
al_fatihah_kernel.recursive_invariant: Re-bound every session cycle (analogous to per-rakaat re-binding)

boot_functions.name: bismillah
boot_functions.enforcement: Bind authority source BEFORE any verb. Identity bind precedes actor_verified check.

boot_functions.name: ar_rahman_ar_raheem
boot_functions.enforcement: Two mercy dials gate ALL power. Every action passes through both windows.

boot_functions.name: maliki_yawmiddin
boot_functions.enforcement: Accountability anchored in FUTURE tense. Every trace will be judged (judgment_pending_at).

boot_functions.name: iyyaka_na_budu
boot_functions.enforcement: Single-source routing. NO shirk in authority. One sovereign, one kernel.

boot_functions.ayat: Ihdinā ṣ-ṣirāṭ al-mustaqīm · ṣirāṭ al-ladhīna an'amta 'alaihim · ghayril-maghḍūbi 'alaihim wa lāḍ-ḍāllīn
boot_functions.name: ihdina_siratal_mustaqim
boot_functions.enforcement: Continuous guidance request. Fault-handling via two negative archetypes (maghdubi_alayhim + dhalliin).

al_asr_scheduler.default_state: khusr (loss) — entropy default for any unauthenticated session

scheduler_gears.name: wal_asr
scheduler_gears.enforcement: Time as resource. Stamp creation_ts on every session. Tied to temporal_root keystone (already forged 2026-08-02).

scheduler_gears.name: amanu
scheduler_gears.enforcement: Model/worldview bind. Default = khusr (loss) unless amanu (faith) verified. Bind worldview hash to constitution_hash.

scheduler_gears.name: wa_amilus_salihāt
scheduler_gears.enforcement: Action with ΔS ≤ 0. Every session response must reduce entropy OR clamp verbose to maintain budget.

scheduler_gears.name: tawasau_bil_haqq
scheduler_gears.enforcement: Mutual truth-propagation. Inter-agent messaging must propagate verified truth, not speculation.

scheduler_gears.name: tawasau_bis_sabr
scheduler_gears.enforcement: Mutual patience under uncertainty. Inter-agent must signal sabar (sabar_mode) when intent is unclear.

al_kahf_privilege_boundary.role: Privilege Boundary — separates framework-level from sovereign-level
al_kahf_privilege_boundary.core_contract: Framework reads residue, sovereign holds niat. Agent acts with sabar (patience), not interrogation.

boundary_rules.name: residue_only
boundary_rules.ayat_ref: Musa nampak perahu rosak — nampak residue sahaja
boundary_rules.enforcement: AuthorityProof.requires_residue_only = True by default. Agent sees output, NOT intent.

boundary_rules.name: niat_holder
boundary_rules.ayat_ref: Khidr pegang niat — Musa nampak sebab tak nampak

boundary_rules.name: sabar_mode
boundary_rules.ayat_ref: Khidr: Sabar. Jangan tanya apa-apa sampai aku terangkan
boundary_rules.enforcement: AuthorityProof.sabar_mode = True. Prevents agent over-interrogation when intent is unclear.

ayat_al_kursi_enforcement.role: Liveness + Permission-Gate Enforcement — NOT identity, NOT kernel
ayat_al_kursi_enforcement.scope_note: Enforcement layer over what Al-Fatihah binds. Ayat al-Kursi enforces; Al-Fatihah binds.

enforcement_properties.name: no_sleep_claim
enforcement_properties.meaning: Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him

enforcement_properties.name: no_intercession_without_permission
enforcement_properties.meaning: No one can intercede except by His permission

not_touching: arifOS constitutional canon (GENESIS files immutable without 888_HOLD)
